title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: Information element that may be included in WB-S1 mode to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN.

entities.name: RACS supported by UE and network
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the operation is in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: Delete network-assigned UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: System behavior where the UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Information element containing the UE radio capability identifier.

relations.description: Inclusion of UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is guarded by the condition that operation is in WB-S1 mode.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE establishes the property that UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs.
Inclusion of UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is guarded by the condition that UE radio capability ID IE shall not be included.
